title: CollaborationArtifact
description: Storage shape of one immutable collaboration artifact version: an ordinary reply or a deterministic query result. Readability is deliberately absent; it exists only on experience_view. Cleanup clears the payload, not the identity, version, digest or authorizations.

artifact_version.description: Artifact version, starting at 1. A v1 artifact is always version 1.

attempt_ref.description: Model attempt that produced the body; null for deterministic_query.

body.description: Artifact text. The storage contract freezes the created shape; after an authorized deletion the payload is cleared and the reference is read through experience_view only.

source_refs.description: Exact sources behind this artifact. Collaboration refs are allowed here; they are never evidence and never a read_set entry.
